name: Jeetu Patel
moniker: Cisco's Chief Product Officer Driving Its AI Pivot
quick_facts: President and Chief Product Officer of Cisco
Previously ran Cisco's Security and Collaboration businesses, including Webex
Before Cisco, held CEO and senior product roles at Box, EMC, and Doculabs
Frequent public voice on enterprise AI strategy and infrastructure
hook: Patel has repeatedly taken charge of businesses at inflection points, remaking Cisco's Collaboration unit around Webex during the pandemic-driven shift to remote work, then its Security business, and now leads product strategy for Cisco's push to build the networking and infrastructure layer for enterprise AI.

achievements.title: Leading Cisco Security and Collaboration
achievements.impact: Oversaw Webex's growth into a major enterprise collaboration platform and Cisco's security portfolio expansion.

achievements.title: Named Cisco President and Chief Product Officer
achievements.impact: Given product authority across Cisco's full portfolio as the company repositions around AI infrastructure and networking.

achievements.title: Cisco's AI-readiness and 'AI-native' networking initiatives
achievements.impact: Positioned Cisco's core networking business as critical infrastructure for enterprise AI deployment.

achievements.title: Senior leadership at Box and EMC prior to Cisco
achievements.impact: Built product and go-to-market experience across cloud content management and enterprise infrastructure.

timeline.event: Joins Cisco to lead the Collaboration business
timeline.impact: Begins Cisco tenure focused on Webex

timeline.event: Webex usage surges amid pandemic remote work
timeline.impact: Collaboration business scales rapidly under his leadership

timeline.event: Takes on leadership of Cisco Security
Named President and Chief Product Officer of Cisco

quote.text: The network is going to become the nervous system for AI.
quote.context: A recurring theme in Patel's public remarks on Cisco's AI infrastructure strategy
